title: Auto-hiding settings bar
description: Add a top-of-screen settings bar that stays hidden and reveals on hover, exposing language pair, subtitle appearance (font size, position, opacity), latency-vs-accuracy model size, and exit.
acceptance_criteria: Bar is hidden by default and appears on hover at the top region
Exposes language pair, font size, position, opacity, model size, and exit
Control state changes emit events the app can subscribe to
